To Whom It May Concern:

The Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) is submitting this request for records under the Illinois Freedom of Information Act. related to the acquisition and cost of services and devices provided by Axon and any of its subsidiaries and partners. 

*Background*
Axon (also known as Axon Enterprise, Inc.) is a company that describes itself as providing “public safety technology solutions” to a variety of customers, many of which are law enforcement agencies based in the United States. For reference, Axon’s website is www.axon.com. These “solutions” may be equipment, software, or “artificial intelligence”-driven analysis of video and data. Some examples of equipment, software, and services created and sold by Axon include (but are not limited to):
• the TASER, a conducted energy device
• body-worn cameras (often referred to as “Axon Body”)
• Axon Fusus, a platform used to integrate cameras and other data into a “real-time crime center” (RTCC) 
• Axon 911, an AI-driven assistant platform for dispatchers
• Axon Evidence, a platform to integrate evidence and other information
• Axon Outpost, an automated license plate reader (ALPR) system
• Axon Lightpost, an ALPR system designed for integration with streetlights
• the Axon AI Era Plan, a collection of AI-driven analysis software (www.axon.com/products/axon-ai-era-plan)
• Axon Vision, an AI-driven video analysis system
• Axon Assistant, an AI-driven chatbot
• Axon Draft One, an AI-assisted police report generation feature
• Axon Records, a records management system
• Axon virtual reality training
• Axon Air DFR, a drone-as-first-responder platform, which may also include drones created by a company called Skydio

Axon provides services or devices to the majority of policing agencies in the United States. Axon often “bundles” services and devices into a single contract, makes adjustments and additions to existing agreements for the provision of new goods, and is designated a “sole source provider” during the procurement process. Contracts and agreements may be active for many years and may include “escalator” clauses that describe ongoing and increasing costs for the procurement over the life of the contract.

*Timeframe*
The requested records are all those related to agreements with Axon active during the year 2026, as well as those agreements related to devices, services, and payments to be provided in the future. 

*Requested records*
This public records request is for materials related to the acquisition and cost of services and devices provided by Axon and any of its subsidiaries and partners. 

1. CONTRACT AND AGREEMENTS
All contracts, memorandums of understanding, and any other written agreements between this agency and Axon. Response records included all associated amendments, exhibits, and supplemental and supporting documentation for each agreement, including any amendments and materials generated subsequent to the initial contract agreement. If this agency uses any Axon product, including but not limited to the ones listed above, agreements referencing those products are responsive to this request; this includes all agreements related to “trial” or “free” periods of use. 

2. FINANCIAL AND PROCUREMENT MATERIALS
All relevant procurement and financial documents and agreements, as well as records of financial transactions, exchanges, and obligations relevant to devices and services procured from Axon. Some of these details and documents may be included as part of the Master Services and Purchasing Agreement or related quotes. 
Responsive materials include: 
• quote materials
• invoices and bills
• records describing specific pricing for each associated line item, including the unit price, the quantity procured of each unit, and associated pricing components. If additional products will be procured over the life of the contract, please be sure to provide records that reflect future acquisitions under the agreement and their cost. 
• receipts
• Requests for Proposal to which Axon provided a response
• bidding materials provided by Axon
• justifications for sole source designation (or equivalent designation, if different terminology is used in your jurisdiction) and associated materials. Responsive materials include any letters and drafts provided by Axon, any supporting materials provided by the company, and any related resolutions and materials generated by the jurisdiction in the process of obtaining a sole source designation for Axon. If the company is not subject to competitive purchasing procedures for a reason that is not a “sole source designation” (for example, because the agreement is part of a cooperative or collaborative purchase), please provide records sufficient to show why the company or the contract is not subject to competitive bidding. 
• records sufficient to show the projected ongoing cost of the agreement with Axon
• records reflecting any discounts or other calculations that were figured into the costs associated with this procurement

*Provision of records*
We ask that these materials be provided on a rolling basis; please provide materials to us as your office collects and reviews records. Please contact us for further discussion regarding the search and release of these materials.

*Fees*
In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform us of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. 
This request is not being made for commercial purposes. Please assess fees appropriately in accordance with a public records request being made in the public interest for research and journalism purposes.

*Format of responsive records*
I request that all records be disclosed in their native, digital format and transmitted to us electronically. 

*Contact information*
If you need any more information in order to process the request, or cannot process a portion of the request for any reason, please respond to the email address on this request or “beryl@eff.org”. Please let us know if a phone call will be necessary or desirable; such contact information will be provided upon request.

Thank you very much for your time and help.

Sincerely,
Beryl Lipton
